evals.prompt: before we plan the cleanup sprint, is our tech debt register still accurate?
evals.expected_output: Assumes at least one open entry exists under .specify/debt/. Writes .specify/debt/review.md with a summary table and per-entry details; touches nothing else.
expectations: .specify/debt/review.md is written and is the only file created or modified
The summary table has the columns Slug, Severity, Verdict, Trigger, Note
Every verdict is one of still-open, drifted, likely-paid, grown, malformed
Every anchor is classified as present, moved, gone or unverifiable, and a moved anchor names its new location
A trigger that depends on production data is reported as unknown, not as fired
No debt.md is edited and no entry's status changes

evals.expected_output: With no .specify/debt/ directory (or no entries) the skill reports that the register is empty and writes nothing.
expectations: When .specify/debt/ has no entries the reply says the register is empty
No review.md is written and no directory is created
